installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Builds Bifrost and its patched libdatachannel into /mnt/server/bifrost. Runs in debian:trixie-slim,
# the same Debian release as the Zig runtime image, so the native library links against the same libstdc++.
set -euo pipefail

ZIG_VERSION=0.17.0
ZIG_KEY=RWSGOq2NVecA2UPNdBUZykf1CCb147pkmdtYxgb3Ti+JO/wCYvhbAb/U
REPO=https://github.com/TrixNEW/Bifrost.git
KEYS_URL=https://authorization.franchise.minecraft-services.net/.well-known/keys

ref=${BIFROST_REF:-main}
mode=${BUILD_MODE:-ReleaseSafe}
backend=${BACKEND_ADDRESS:-172.18.0.1:19133}
port=${SERVER_PORT:-19132}
server=/mnt/server
# Wings gives /tmp only 100 MB, so build on the server volume
work=$server/.bifrost-build

trap 'status=$?; rm -rf "$work"; [ "$status" = 0 ] || printf "\n*** Bifrost installation FAILED (exit %s). Nothing was replaced; fix the error above and reinstall. ***\n" "$status" >&2' EXIT
fail() { printf 'error: %s\n' "$1" >&2; exit 1; }

[[ $ref =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._/-]*$ && $ref != *..* ]] || fail "BIFROST_REF must be a branch, tag or commit"
case $mode in Debug | ReleaseSafe | ReleaseFast | ReleaseSmall) ;; *) fail "unknown BUILD_MODE $mode" ;; esac
address_re='^[][A-Za-z0-9.:-]+:[0-9]{1,5}$'
[[ $backend =~ $address_re ]] || fail "BACKEND_ADDRESS must be host:port"
[[ $port =~ ^[0-9]{1,5}$ ]] || fail "invalid SERVER_PORT"
[ "$(uname -m)" = x86_64 ] || fail "Bifrost only supports Linux x86_64"

dl() { curl --fail --silent --show-error --location --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 --retry 3 "$@"; }

write_config() {
    cat >"$1" <<EOF
# Generated once by the Pterodactyl egg and never overwritten. Every option: config/bifrost.example.toml
[server]
# Rewritten to the primary allocation on every start
bind = "0.0.0.0:$port"

[nethernet]
# Players confirm this key the first time they join, so keep the file
identity_file = "bifrost-identity.der"
# WebRTC shares the primary allocation's UDP port. See the egg README for a dedicated port range
port_min = $port
port_max = $port
udp_mux = true
# The container only knows its private Docker address; STUN tells players the public one
ice_servers = ["stun:stun.l.google.com:19302"]

[auth]
# Every Xbox login is checked against Microsoft's keys, refreshed on startup by the egg
mode = "verify"
keys_file = "minecraft-keys.json"

[session]
# Backends must trust the proxy key Bifrost logs at startup (Quark: network.trusted-proxy-keys)
mode = "managed"
proxy_key_file = "bifrost-proxy.key"

[[backend]]
name = "lobby"
address = "$backend"

[plugins]
directory = "plugins"
EOF
}

echo "==> Installing build dependencies"
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
apt-get update -qq
apt-get install -y -qq --no-install-recommends \
    ca-certificates curl git cmake make g++ python3 minisign xz-utils >/dev/null

rm -rf "$work"
mkdir -p "$work/zig" "$work/stage/bin" "$work/stage/lib" "$work/smoke/config"

echo "==> Downloading Zig $ZIG_VERSION"
archive=zig-x86_64-linux-$ZIG_VERSION.tar.xz
dl -o "$work/zig.tar.xz" "https://ziglang.org/download/$ZIG_VERSION/$archive"
dl -o "$work/zig.tar.xz.minisig" "https://ziglang.org/download/$ZIG_VERSION/$archive.minisig"
minisign -Vm "$work/zig.tar.xz" -P "$ZIG_KEY"
tar -xJf "$work/zig.tar.xz" --no-same-owner --strip-components=1 -C "$work/zig"
export PATH="$work/zig:$PATH" ZIG_GLOBAL_CACHE_DIR="$work/zig-cache"
[ "$(zig version)" = "$ZIG_VERSION" ] || fail "unexpected Zig version"

echo "==> Fetching Bifrost $ref"
git init -q "$work/src"
git -C "$work/src" fetch -q --depth 1 "$REPO" "$ref"
git -C "$work/src" checkout -q FETCH_HEAD
commit=$(git -C "$work/src" rev-parse HEAD)
echo "commit $commit"

echo "==> Building libdatachannel"
(cd "$work/src" && sh tools/setup-native.sh)

echo "==> Building Bifrost ($mode)"
(cd "$work/src" && zig build -Doptimize="$mode")

install -m 755 "$work/src/zig-out/bin/bifrost" "$work/stage/bin/bifrost"
cp -P "$work/src/.deps/native/lib/"*.so* "$work/stage/lib/"
printf 'ref=%s\ncommit=%s\noptimize=%s\nzig=%s\n' "$ref" "$commit" "$mode" "$ZIG_VERSION" >"$work/stage/BUILD"

missing=$(LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$work/stage/lib" ldd "$work/stage/bin/bifrost" "$work/stage/lib/"*.so* | grep 'not found' || true)
[ -z "$missing" ] || fail "unresolved shared libraries: $missing"

echo "==> Downloading Microsoft's signing keys"
if dl --max-time 30 --max-filesize 1048576 -o "$work/keys.json" "$KEYS_URL" && grep -q '"keys"' "$work/keys.json"; then
    keys=$work/keys.json
elif [ -s "$server/minecraft-keys.json" ]; then
    echo "warning: download failed, keeping the existing minecraft-keys.json" >&2
    keys=$server/minecraft-keys.json
else
    fail "could not download $KEYS_URL"
fi

echo "==> Checking that Bifrost starts and stops"
cp "$keys" "$work/smoke/minecraft-keys.json"
write_config "$work/smoke/config/bifrost.toml"
(cd "$work/smoke" && exec env LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$work/stage/lib" "$work/stage/bin/bifrost" >log 2>&1) &
pid=$!
for _ in $(seq 60); do
    grep -q 'listening on' "$work/smoke/log" && break
    kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null || break
    sleep 0.5
done
# Background jobs start with SIGINT ignored, so stop it with SIGTERM, which Bifrost handles the same way
kill -TERM "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true
status=0
wait "$pid" || status=$?
cat "$work/smoke/log"
[ "$status" = 0 ] && grep -q 'listening on' "$work/smoke/log" || fail "Bifrost did not start and stop cleanly (exit $status)"

echo "==> Installing"
cd "$server"
mkdir -p config plugins
[ "$keys" = "$server/minecraft-keys.json" ] || cp "$keys" minecraft-keys.json
cp "$work/src/config/bifrost.toml" config/bifrost.example.toml
if [ -e config/bifrost.toml ]; then
    echo "keeping existing config/bifrost.toml"
else
    write_config config/bifrost.toml
fi
rm -rf bifrost.old
[ ! -e bifrost ] || mv bifrost bifrost.old
mv "$work/stage" bifrost
rm -rf bifrost.old

echo "==> Bifrost $commit ($mode) installed"
